steps.content: You come around to find yourself surrounded by darkness. You have a vague feeling that you haven't left the interrogation room, but everything around you is blurry.
Your nostrils are assaulted by a familiar unpleasant smell. The smell of the Rust.
Fear not, my friend. The curtain to the Starry Theater is about to rise... Please enjoy!
A voice in your head demands your attention. It's Serpent's voice. As soon as she makes the announcement, all your senses, switched on like light bulbs, are drawn to the stage before you.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Here comes... Act one of the story.

steps.speaker: Merchant
steps.content: **** this shithole! Monsters everywhere. Hope this load of goods can survive the trip to Eastside.

steps.speaker: Merchant
steps.content: Those Syndican idiots... they clung to me like a bad cold when they smelt a chance of going to Eastside. There's no shaking them off.

steps.speaker: Merchant
steps.content: **** whatever. Those bad boys in the back aren't vegetarians anyway!

The view before you clears up. You see what looks like the inside of a truck trailer. Gigantic boxes are piled high, inside one of which there's a black snake wrapping itself tightly around an object.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: And this is where our heroine starts her journey in search of happiness.
You see Serpent by your side. She points at the long snake, inviting you to take a closer look. It's only then that you make out the object enveloped by the snake. It's a girl.
The snake is resting its head against the side of her neck, its forked tongue flicking. She clutches her wrist, her lips bloodless.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Come and enjoy the show with me! And... experience it with me...
Serpent's voice turns dreamy, and your vision goes blurry for some reason. You feel there's something wrapped around your body.

The shackles have linked your psyche and consciousness to those of someone else. Your heart is beating faster, your skin is turning cold, and every inch of your body is aching. Along with these sensations comes an intoxicating mirage.
Then it hits you: You're feeling what the girl is feeling. She stowed away with others in a truck trailer, but little did she know that she was to travel with snakes.

steps.speaker: Merchant
steps.content: The batch is topnotch. Those *** in Eastside have paid good money for them. When the transaction is done, what do you say we go have a happy time in Eastside?

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Happy...? What is it like?
A gruff voice comes through from the cab. The girl cranes her neck, trying to catch what the man is saying.

steps.speaker: Merchant
steps.content: Syndicate is a *** place. It has nothing going for it. We may have to survive on the monsters one day! Eastside is another story. It has everything you can ever dream of. You don't have to worry about anything in Eastside.

steps.speaker: Merchant
steps.content: Yeah, with the money from the deal, we can have fun for the rest of our lives in Eastside. The best wine and ****... we can have whatever we want! Every day will be a happy day!

steps.speaker: Merchant
steps.content: That's the happiest place in the entire DisCity!
The snake venom courses through her veins as she listens to the merchant babbling on. Her hallucinations are getting more intense by the minute.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Eastside... there's happiness to be found... in Eastside?

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Will my pain become... less severe, if I find... happiness?
Just before her life drains away completely, something in her vision seems to inject into her a new desire for life...

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Let me go find happiness, Let me... live!

You feel your heartbeat increases and your breathing quickens. Every inch of your body is in excruciating pain, but at the same time, you feel itchy all over, an itch that runs deep and thorough, as if there's a new body growing inside of you.
It wants to free itself from the fetters of the past, to rid itself of all long-established weaknesses...
You're soaked through with sweat when it's done and dusted. With an effort, you lift your head to look around. The girl has freed herself from the snake's embrace and is now sitting next to it.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Thank you... for showing me the visions. I'll get that kind of happiness, right?

The girl strokes the snake gently, her vertical pupils filled with ferocious longing. The snake, which almost killed her a moment ago but utterly fears her now, is lying at her feet, as docile as a pet.
You sense the reason why the snake is afraid of her. It's because she holds extraordinary powers, and because she is even crazier than the snake—she has become a Sinner.
Thud! Thud! You hear the sound of something being hammered. Then shafts of bright white light burst in.
You shield your eyes with your hand against the sudden glare.

steps.speaker: Man
steps.content: What the **** is this?
When the glare subsides, you see two people standing in front of you. They are looking at the load of a truck trailer.
A smartly-dressed man is holding a device pointed at the wooden crates. Looks like he's making a recording.

steps.speaker: Man
steps.content: Tsk! I paid for the snake, not for all these humans! Thank goodness I didn't press the Live button. If I had, and the world saw this, you'd be in big trouble!

steps.speaker: Merchant
steps.content: Hey, this baby is very vicious; it hasn't developed an appetite for ordinary foods yet! That's why we included... some stuff to tide you over.

steps.speaker: Man
steps.content: Oh! That's great. Let me pick a good-looking one for my baby then.
Hearing the conversation between the two men, the "Syndican idiots" in the trailer moved away from the door, and some of them even passed out.
But the girl stood up and walked over to the man.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Are you from Eastside?

steps.speaker: Man
steps.content: You can speak?

steps.speaker: Man
steps.content: Yep, this is the legendary Eastside! You got to see it before you die... Count yourself lucky.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Take me with you, please.

steps.speaker: Man
steps.content: Huh? Are you listening to yourself?

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: I want to... find happiness here.

steps.speaker: Man
steps.content: ...Are you crazy? Ummm... But if that's what you want... I guess we can find a way to make it work.

steps.speaker: Merchant
steps.content: Fantastic! You've been living with this young gentleman's goods. You two must be good friends, right?

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Friends... Yes, we're friends.
The girl smiled, revealing her pointed canine teeth.
She crouched down and whispered something to the black snake. It raises its body shakily from the floor and stares the man in the face, its forked tongue out.

steps.speaker: Man
steps.content: Wait... You... you can speak to the snake?!

steps.speaker: Man
steps.content: **** me! This is gonna be big!!

steps.speaker: Man
steps.content: Say something more. Go on!!
The man, overcome with excitement, yells encouragement at the girl with his phone held aloft.
She instructs the snake to carry out each and every one of his requests, all in the hope of being taken on a journey to happiness.
<color=#e45515>That's how she came to stay in Eastside.</color>
From that day forward, the <color=#e45515>girl who can speak to snakes</color> became popular on the internet.
Because of her popularity, she gets to wear <color=#e45515>dresses</color> that she has never dreamed of wearing, eat <color=#e45515>foods</color> that she has never dreamed of eating.
What her audience doesn't know was that... Off camera, she still had to live next to a pet house <color=#e45515>in the courtyard</color>.
<color=#e45515>No one</color> cares what she thinks, <color=#e45515>no one</color> understands how she feels, and her <color=#e45515>only</color> source of warmth is the cold-blooded snake.
On stage, the family's house is <color=#e45515>expanding</color>, along with the <color=#e45515>pet house</color>.
<color=#e45515>The only thing not growing is the nest beside the pet house.</color>

steps.speaker: Man
steps.content: Huh, what's that look? You want to rebel?

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: I thought... You could bring me happiness.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: The things you've given me... they can't make me happy at all. They make me tired, they cause me pain...

steps.speaker: Man
steps.content: I spared your life to bring me happiness! Money makes me happy! Understood?!

steps.speaker: Man
steps.content: So be quiet and make money! That's your only job.
The man stumbles drunkenly into his room, a bottle in his hand.

steps.speaker: Man
steps.content: I'm the only reason you're still alive. Don't fantasize about getting things you don't deserve. Like I told you...

steps.speaker: Man
steps.content: Some people are meant to be the downtrodden; that's their fate.
The man and Serpent say in unison. Then the door is slammed shut.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: You want happiness? I want it too...

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: But can you get it in some other way...? In a way that doesn't hurt me and take my happiness away. This is not the right way...
The girl stands motionless in the garden, her face turned skywards, not making a sound.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: How about this? I'll give you another kind of happiness, the kind of true happiness I once experienced... You're gonna love it.
You see all the doors in the house close one by one. And then you hear a rustling sound; something is slithering around.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Hahaha! Dreams, happiness, everything here is going to be shrouded in happiness!
A serpentine shape flies past before your eyes. And then you see something oozing out from under the doors, staining the carpet.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: That's... the Pet Snake Case?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Hold on, you did that with snake venom and your power?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Is this really your Realm of Dreams?

choices.text: Is this really your Realm of Dreams?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But your dreams...
You want to say that this is not happiness, but you can't get the words out, because at that very moment, your heartbeat skyrockets, as if you're about to drop dead.

Your senses slowly become entwined with those of the character in the show. You feel as if you're trapped in a house from which you can't escape. A myriad of emotions rises in you: anger, disdain, and... a strange excitement.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: It's a story, a show, not a sweet dream brought about by Ambrosia.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: But... aren't you feeling happy?
You can't move, and Serpent looks at you with a smile on her face.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: You told me to look for true happiness. I did, and I've found it, the sort of happiness that belongs only to me! I want you to experience it too, so you can build your own happy dreams...

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Be patient. We're going to experience more of it... You'll love it, I promise.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Anyway, the man was right about one thing though, that this place is the only path that leads to the happiness back then.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: So, when the path disappeared, she was in a daze.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Where should I go? Where can I find true happiness?
You see the girl wandering aimlessly around the streets.
A woman accosted her. The girl stopped in her tracks.

steps.speaker: Talent Scout
steps.content: Wow! Miss, I've seen your performance on the dar... On the internet.

steps.speaker: Talent Scout
steps.content: Really exciting, insanely thrilling! Ooh, that was a real snake!

steps.speaker: Talent Scout
steps.content: Here you are, in the flesh. Oh my gosh, you're amazing; the look in your eyes and your aura are simply perfection. You're literally the embodiment of insanity and craziness!

steps.speaker: Talent Scout
steps.content: Sorry about what happened to your ow... Your agent. But don't feel sad; we can do a better job of helping you than him.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Helping me...?

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Can you... make me happy?

steps.speaker: Talent Scout
steps.content: Of course! Whoever has signed with us is living a life of happiness and merry-making.
The scene on stage starts changing. It swirls and spins, and eventually a new scene comes to existence before you.
You recognize it as the entertainment company you came upon while investigating Ambrosia.

steps.speaker: Talent Scout
steps.content: If you sign with us, you'll be as happy as you want to be!

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: You must keep your word; I'll find happiness.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: I'll find happiness if I sign with you.

steps.speaker: Talent Scout
steps.content: Yes, yes, definitely!
The woman pushed a pen across the table in the office. The girl didn't hesitate for a moment before she picked it up and signed the contract.

steps.speaker: Talent Scout
steps.content: Great, from now on, you're an artist of our company. Apply yourself to make more profits.

steps.speaker: Talent Scout
steps.content: ...With your partner, of course.
The talent scout put the contract away and pointed at the object around the girl's arm.
It's the black snake that once put the girl's life in danger. It has succumbed to her power, and has willingly become a part of her being by shrinking in size and then wrapping itself around her arm.

steps.speaker: Actress A
steps.content: Big deal! She's just riding the wave of her old reputation on the darknet as the so-called “girl who can speak with snakes.” That's just playing on people's desire for novelty. But the novelty will wear off, and she'll become worthless!

steps.speaker: Actress B
steps.content: Sigh... She is getting traffic, so it's understandable why they're providing her with tons of resources. I hear she even gets to attend private parties of the upper class now.

steps.speaker: Actress A
steps.content: Pfft, who knows how she pulled that off! The way she carries herself... it makes me sick. Why the pretense? She's just a tool for making money.
The girl hears a high-pitched voice coming from inside the green room as she walks past.

steps.speaker: Actress A
steps.content: A tool is entitled to nothing. I'd love to see if she can keep up her smile in front of the camera when she...
The girl's communications device beeps. She's just received a message from her agent.

steps.speaker: Text Message
steps.content: "Great performance! You've done a wonderful job!"

steps.speaker: Text Message
steps.content: "Tonight, you'll be performing for a private banquet downtown. The host liked your performance earlier today, and wants you there to liven things up."

steps.speaker: Text Message
steps.content: "Someone will come and pick you up momentarily. This is a great opportunity. Don't blow it."

steps.speaker: Text Message
steps.content: "It's going to be a happy occasion. I think... You're gonna love it!"
The girl stares at the message for a long while before bursting into the green room.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: I don't care what will happen to me when the novelty wears off. At least I can provide such novelty!

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: It would do you good if you could spend some time thinking about how to find your own happiness... instead of gossiping all day.
The girl storms out of the room, without a backward glance.
The scene on stage changes again. You and the girl, as if dragged along by some unseen force, arrive at the tallest building downtown.
The innermost hall, where the banquet is held, has been turned into a brightly-lit place of entertainment.
All the guests are wearing revolting getups, and grotesque domino masks underneath which are fake scars created with makeup.
They cheer the girl dancing with her snake on stage.

steps.speaker: Guest
steps.content: You're the best monster here! A real monster!!
The last remark of the guests fades away; for a long time afterward, only music can be heard in the brightly-lit room.
You raise your head involuntarily, fighting to ward off the emotions the girl is conveying to you: distaste, disgust, and disdain.
On stage, the girl is sitting with her small snake nuzzling up against her cheek affectionately. Off stage, confusion and disorder reign.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: What you brought me was not happiness either. Why? She said... that this would be a happy occasion.
Lying at her feet is a wide-eyed "monster", looking at the girl and squeezing out a broken sentence.

steps.speaker: Guest
steps.content: You... you are... just a tool... tool... for making us happy...
You realize the situation immediately.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Serpent, you're slipping deeper and deeper... Wake up, before it's too late.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: That's not a place where she can find happiness either. She still has to look for it... by herself.

Serpent ignores you and falls silent. You turn your attention back to the stage. Music floating, light dancing, the girl comes to the center of the hall and picks up a magazine with filth all over it.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Girl and Snake... Novelty... Monster...

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Heheh... Right, how come I never thought of it? The reason I can't find happiness, is because I'm a monster.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: A monster... that's what they've been calling me. They called me a monster just now.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: I've been unhappy since the very beginning. I've never been able to find true happiness that belongs to me... I can't find it among humans.
Then the girl's mask-like face is cracked open by a spooky smile as she flips through the magazine, which is peppered with pictures of monsters, as if looking for something.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: So... where can I find happiness as a monster?! Where?!

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Ah, Endless... Carnival?
Your emotions are in tumult, your consciousness runs wild, and your shackles start throbbing violently. You sense that the Mania inside her is quivering, ready to break out and wreak havoc.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Serpent, you mustn't go there. You're not a monster.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You can't find happiness there!
The tumult of emotions keeps on running into you through the shackles. In your state of confusion, you hear a voice.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Let's go together... To find the ultimate happiness!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Serpent, let's go...
Serpent's voice is full of enchantment. You almost want to say yes to her invitation without thinking about it.
A tingling sensation comes over you. It's a warning from the shackles, an instinctive reaction.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I'm not going with you, Serpent.

choices.text: I'm not going with you, Serpent.

steps.content: All the emotions that have just seized you retreat in a tide. You see the person before you.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: ...You're so stubborn.
Serpent leans gently against your knee, her hand still holding yours, so tightly that your fingers hurt.

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Almost there. You'll see it in a moment...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Serpent, you look sick. What's the matter?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I don't know what you've done to me. But you can't go on like this, you must stop exhausting yourself, you...

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: I understand... why you're refusing my offer of happiness. Because you don't think this happiness is satisfying enough for you, right? It's okay, it's okay...

steps.speaker: Serpent
steps.content: Any minute now, we're going to experience happiness on a grander scale, a happiness that's more eternal!
Your surroundings blur again, and you realize that Serpent is about to resume telling her story.
This Sinner before you, connected to you through the shackles, is oozing danger. You feel everything she is feeling.

You know that Serpent is baring her soul to you, and that she will drag you under with her. But this girl, whose life force is draining away fast, is still smiling at you, though with an effort, and wanting to share true happiness with you...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Lay it on me, let me feel everything you've gone through, if you so wish.
